Nelflow.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable NPC Strike Auto-Resolution
Nelflow.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Automatically continue eligible GM-authored NPC Strikes against one target.
Nelflow.Settings.AutoApply.Name: Automatically Apply Strike Damage
Nelflow.Settings.AutoApply.Hint: When disabled, Nelflow rolls damage but leaves PF2e's native damage controls for manual application.
Nelflow.Settings.EnableUndo.Name: Show Undo for Automatically Applied Damage
Nelflow.Settings.EnableUndo.Hint: Allow GMs to restore the recorded HP and temporary HP when the target has not changed since application.
Nelflow.Settings.CompactTurnStacks.Name: Compact Turn Stacks
Nelflow.Settings.CompactTurnStacks.Hint: Group supported Nelflow actions into durable compact chat summaries. Additional action modes may be added in future versions.
Nelflow.Settings.CollapseLinkedNativeCar: Collapse linked PF2e attack, damage, and application cards while keeping their native content and controls available.
Nelflow.Settings.StackFirstNativeRecords: Choose whether compact linked PF2e audit stubs remain visible or are hidden behind their exact Nelflow stack control.
Nelflow.Settings.Debug.Name: Enable Debug Logging
Nelflow.Settings.Debug.Hint: Log concise Strike and transaction diagnostics to the browser console.
Nelflow.Status.UndoTitle: Restore the recorded HP and temporary HP
Nelflow.Stack.DetailsAria: Expand row details and native message links
Nelflow.Stack.ActionsNamedTitle: Open the native attack record for: {actions}. Nelflow does not evaluate availability.
Nelflow.Stack.ActionsUnknownTitle: Open the native attack record. This attack contains supplemental controls; Nelflow does not evaluate availability.
Nelflow.Reason.TargetMismatch: the recorded Strike target does not match the selected target
Nelflow.Reason.UnresolvedStrike: the originating Strike could not be identified safely
Nelflow.Reason.UnsupportedEnvironment: this Foundry or PF2e version does not expose the verified APIs
Nelflow.Reason.DamageMessageMissing: PF2e created no identifiable damage message
Nelflow.Reason.NativeApplyUnavailable: PF2e's native damage pathway is unavailable
Nelflow.Notification.NoTarget: Nelflow skipped this Strike: target exactly one token.
Nelflow.Notification.MultipleTargets: Nelflow skipped this Strike: multiple targets are not supported.
Nelflow.Notification.TargetMismatch: Nelflow skipped this Strike because its recorded target was ambiguous.
Nelflow.Notification.UnresolvedStrike: Nelflow could not identify the originating Strike safely.
Nelflow.Notification.ApplyFailed: Nelflow could not apply damage safely. Use PF2e's native damage controls.
Nelflow.Notification.UndoChanged: Undo blocked: the target's HP or temporary HP changed after Nelflow applied damage.
Nelflow.Notification.UndoUnavailable: Undo is no longer available for this transaction.
Nelflow.Notification.UndoFailed: Nelflow could not restore the recorded HP safely.
Nelflow.Notification.NativeMessageUnavai: The linked native PF2e message is no longer available.
Nelflow.Notification.NativeMessageNotRen: The linked native PF2e message is available but is not currently rendered in chat.
